records.name: Existing orchard
records.description: The existing orchard is shown in Unit 1 field photographs. Current varieties, counts, harvest and condition require a dated field inventory.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Resident hens
records.description: The resident hens and current enclosure appear in field photographs. This is separate from the proposed Poultry Palace. Egg availability and flock counts are not connected.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Poultry Palace
records.description: The documented lotus-inspired sanctuary design includes opening roof petals, protected hen spaces, forage gardens and a central local Tree hub. Construction has not begun.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Poultry Palace Tree
records.description: Proposed local receiving, filtration, measurement and distribution hub. Drinking-water backup, circuit separation, service access and safe overflow require engineering and field validation.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Flowering walkway
records.location: Proposed Palace to Little ARK corridor
records.description: The existing design connects the sanctuary and sharing station with shade, planting, cooling and a fish-viewing feature. Two visible water columns are proposed; the hydraulics remain unresolved.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Little ARK sharing station
records.description: A future welcoming screen, seating, books, produce, eggs and cold refreshments. No stock, dispensing, refrigeration or kiosk recognition is connected to this app. Help remains available without a phone or account.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Serviceable cartridges
records.description: Modular filtration and specialized treatment interfaces need keyed fittings, isolation and cleaning access. Medication and additive dispensing remain unvalidated design concepts, with no controls in this app.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Food and productive shade
records.description: Candidate plans include grapevines, seasonal vegetables and food-bearing shade. Varieties, dates, seed inventory and actual planting are not confirmed here.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Flowering and cooling gardens
records.description: Honeysuckle and jasmine are candidates subject to species suitability. Gardenias and blueberries are microclimate experiments, not proven desert crops.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.

records.name: Native habitat and hen forage
records.location: Proposed restoration and safe forage areas
records.description: Colorado Desert natives, safe hen forage, pollinator habitat, mulch and protected planting are proposed. Species selection and establishment need field records.
records.recordSource: Dawn’s project handoff, November 10, 2026; current inventory and construction require separate dated evidence.
